subject: Hot-path validation & warm-start snapshot request for ClearPay recovery
messages:
From: Alexandra Stone <a.stone@clearpay.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Recovery snapshot and hot-path validation for ClearPay

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG review we've been asked to provide a short, runnable package showing how Redwood would recover ClearPay production traffic in a warm-standby scenario and evidence for observed RTO/RPO from the most recent execution. Specifically we need: 

- A compact runbook (steps to activate warm-standby and promote endpoints)
- Measured RTO and RPO numbers from the last full rehearsal (timestamps + logs or traces)
- Notes about KV cache warm times and any manual steps required for traffic routing
- A proposed 45-minute witness window where we (ClearPay ops) will observe the canary activation and validate traffic continuity

Can you provide these artifacts and confirm a likely witness window next week? We need this for our security/compliance binder by 2027-04-26.

Also looping in our DevOps lead, Marcus Li (m.li@clearpay.com) — he'll want to coordinate the test window.

Appreciate it,
Alexandra
Alexandra Stone
Head of Platform Security
ClearPay

Alexandra — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a focused evidence package for the SIG binder. High level plan: 

1) I will assemble a trimmed runbook that covers warm-standby activation, DNS/edge promotion, and rollback steps.
2) We'll export the RTO/RPO snapshot from our last tabletop and the DR drill (we ran a warm-standby activation on 2027-03-28).
3) Kimberly will add a short section on KV cache warm behaviour and warming scripts we run during activation.
4) Propose witness window: Wed 2027-04-21 16:00-16:45 ET. If that doesn't work we'll propose Thu morning.

Deliverables by EOD Monday 2027-04-19: runbook PDF, CSV of measured timings, and a one-page checklist. Can you confirm the witness window and whether Marcus needs direct VPN access or just a session invite?

I'll attach artifacts when Kimberly drops them in.

—Jordan

Jordan — I pulled the artifacts from the post-dr runbook vault and condensed them. Included here: 

- warm-standby-runbook_v3.pdf (concise runbook with CLI snippets and routing playbook)
- rto-rpo-snapshot-20270328.csv (timings from the 03-28 activation)
- warmstart-checklist.md (operator checklist to run during the witness)

Notes/highlights from the drill: 
- Activation start -> traffic acceptance (edge DNS & LB switch): median 9m 40s, 95th percentile 12m 30s. We measured this across three parallel regions during the test.
- RPO observed: under 30s for user-facing state; session affinity cache reconstruction accounted for most of the delta.
- KV cache warm plan: automated warmed-keys replay (script included) reduces user-facing miss rate in ~3min after activation; we document fallback for cold-cache spikes.
- Manual intervention: none required for service-registration; ops must monitor behind-the-scenes rollouts (health checks may require small throttles for long-tail jobs).

I've attached the three files to this message. Ben — can you add a one-paragraph statement about retention of activation traces for the binder?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Principal Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
